dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Two visible white horizontal bands; the superior band is thick with high grayscale contrast against the blue-gray background, while the inferior band is narrower and less continuous.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High-contrast white terminal and marginal edges on folded secondaries and tertials, creating sharp linear boundaries against dark blue and black regions.

other_distinctive_markers: Strongly defined black transverse barring present across the blue and white sections of the secondary and tertial feathers.
